brief: Write three static Meta ad copy variants for a parent who has already seen the Peach Bucket kit and wants to know what help is available if they get stuck with installation. Answer that buying question directly using the supplied support claim. Do not make up support hours, appointment availability, tools or setup time. This is a hypothetical retargeting brief, not observed campaign data.

variants.primary_text: If you get stuck while fitting childproofing at home, help is available. The Peach Bucket 6-in-1 child safety kit comes with 1-to-1 installation video support, so you don’t have to figure it out alone. The kit has edge and corner protectors, socket guards, cabinet and fridge locks, and door guards. Adult supervision is still necessary.
variants.headline: 1-to-1 Installation Video Support

variants.concept: Help with a kit that has different parts
variants.primary_text: Not sure how to approach all the different pieces? The Peach Bucket 6-in-1 child safety kit includes 1-to-1 installation video support if you need help fitting the kit. It includes edge and corner protectors, socket guards, cabinet and fridge locks, and door guards. Adult supervision remains necessary.
variants.headline: Get Help Installing the 6-in-1 Kit

variants.concept: Answer the installation question before purchase
